title: Low Mach number limit of the compressible Navier-Stokes system for large initial date with critical regularity on the torus
summary: We study the low Mach number limit of the compressible Navier-Stokes equations on the torus. For large initial data with critical regularity, we prove that solutions to the compressible Navier-Stokes system exist as long as the corresponding solutions to the incompressible Navier-Stokes system exist, provided that the Mach number is sufficiently small. Furthermore, we establish the convergence of solutions of the compressible system to those of the incompressible system as the Mach number tends to zero.
